reviews.text: Very professional and competent Doctors

I took my dog ​​to an emergency room because he couldn't stand on his hind legs. They immediately ran all the tests (exorbitant fees - blood tests and a heart check-up cost €500). According to them, he had a neurological problem and needed immediate anesthesia and a CT scan. (The dog is 11 years old, so any anesthesia should be administered ONLY IF NECESSARY.) Knowing that the best neurology clinic in Milan is at another clinic, I stopped there and said I didn't want to proceed. I went to a neurological clinic elsewhere to possibly do a CT scan, and they told me he simply had arthritis on his tail, so he fell off. After anti-inflammatories and 15 days of rest, he was fine, and even now (he's now 13 years old) he only suffers from it sporadically. This is my experience.

I want to thank the team for always providing us with excellent care.
Tano is in excellent health thanks to the doctor who has been guiding us every step of the way through his recovery.
A very positive experience: super professional doctors, warm welcome, and impeccable specialist visits. Thank you so much!
Excelente servicie. Very caring and attentive staff

Totally approved!
We came in to ask for information because we have a Husky puppy, and the girl at the front desk was super nice and thorough!
Thanks also from our little Lucy, who really enjoyed the cookie ❤️
We'll definitely be back, especially because she made us feel at ease right away and because we'll get the care of true professionals!!
I took my Maltese for a check-up and I must say that the girl at the door was very kind and polite and explained all the options for our balaky. We will definitely take the recommended package.

Our cat, Lilly, and I have been clients of this clinic since we moved to the area and have always been very satisfied with the care we received, but a special thanks goes to Dr. Martina Iannino. We're about to move to England, and over the past month, she's been incredibly helpful, kind, and patient, going above and beyond to help us, taking care of the paperwork and making sure Lilly was ready for the trip.

Thank you again, Doctor, it was truly a pleasure!

We have had the best experience with Animal Doctor veterinarian clinic and wouldn't bring our two cats anywhere else. The team speaks perfect English so international customers are also welcome and will not have any communication issues. Dr Valencia and his team are professional, transparent and they instantly put four-legged patients and their owners at ease. It’s obvious that they care a lot about the animals and are taking all precaution’s to ensure your pets are safe and receiving the best care possible.

This is the best vet in Milan, not only are they caring and helpful. They are not there to overcharge you. Very fair and transparent. Added plus is that they are super welcoming to expats and tourists. Everyone speaks english, is super understanding and they help you even beyond what falls under their responsibilities. Its an amazing place for those with pets both non italian and italian. True gem and despite being in a central location the prices are also fair.
Very kind and friendly.

Not all vets here know cats well. At least the vet I visited didn't. He couldn't diagnose a common dermatitis in cats and knew nothing about the anatomy and science of female cats, in particular. I advise cat lovers to find a clinic where all the vets are genuine cat experts, or a clinic that assigns a feline specialist when booking a cat appointment.

If I could, I'd give even more stars!
I came here with a tumor diagnosis for my dog, not knowing what to do, and everyone took care of her and me too. Their kindness, empathy, helpfulness, and attentiveness, along with their undeniable professionalism and expertise, made our journey much easier. Infinite thanks to all the staff, and an extra thank you to Dr. Valencia for supporting and putting up with me throughout this journey!

The entire place, besides being professional, is made up of people who inspire confidence, and that's very important to me and my pet's health.
Excellent veterinarian, the entire staff is very friendly, and Dr. Valencia is very professional and kind. I trust him to look after my dog's health.
